summary: First iteration end-to-end test of Rari Ethnic MVP. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests passing (products list/filter, get by slug, orders create+retrieve, subscribe email/phone/validation, contact). Frontend: full E2E user journey verified on desktop (1920) and mobile (390) - home hero+countdown+WhatsApp float, header/mobile nav, category page (filter+sort+grid), product detail (size selection, add-to-cart validation, cart drawer), 3-step checkout (contact/address/payment/COD) with real order creation returning RE-prefixed order number, order confirmation page with WhatsApp CTA, Navratri landing, Size Guide (chart table present), Contact form submission, Footer newsletter signup. WhatsApp links correctly use wa.me/919316565117. Free-shipping-under-2000 messaging works.

minor.issue: Accepts raw dict (payload: dict) instead of a Pydantic model — no schema-level validation of required fields (name/email/message). Currently ContactMessage(**payload) will raise 500 on missing fields instead of 422. Consider ContactCreate Pydantic model.
No stock decrement on order creation. Not blocking for MVP but a real inventory concern.
No dedup — same email can subscribe repeatedly. Minor.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Only N left' badge on category grid lacks data-testid='stock-urgency' (only present on ProductDetail). Not strictly required by spec but inconsistent.

issues: <title> is default 'Emergent | Fullstack App' — set brand title 'Rari Ethnic — Ethnic wear from Surat' in /app/frontend/public/index.html for SEO/social sharing.

action_items: (Optional/Low) Add data-testid='stock-urgency' to ProductCard badge for consistency with ProductDetail.
(Optional/Low) Replace /api/contact 'payload: dict' with a Pydantic ContactCreate model for proper 422 validation.
(Optional/Low) Update <title> tag in frontend/public/index.html to brand-specific title.
(Optional) Decrement product stock on order creation (or check availability) to make the 'Only N left' urgency real.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: create_contact uses `payload: dict` — should use a Pydantic request model for validation and OpenAPI docs.
server.py file (~490 lines) is fine size-wise but seed_products would be cleaner in a separate file (backend/seed.py) if the catalog grows.
No product stock reservation/decrement on order — acceptable for MVP but must be flagged as roadmap.
CartContext uses localStorage — confirmed persistence but no schema versioning; consider a version key for future migrations.
seed_data_creation: None created by testing agent. 12 products auto-seeded by backend on startup verified. Test orders/subscribers/contact-messages inserted with TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 16 backend pytests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py pass against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Full E2E frontend journey (browse → PDP → add-to-cart → 3-step checkout → order confirmation) verified. Real product slug for 'Meher Maroon Chikankari Kurti' is 'meher-maroon-kurti' (NOT 'meher-maroon-chikankari-kurti' as the review request example showed; review-request 'festive-edit-1' referred to the preview subdomain, not a product slug). Free-shipping threshold ₹2,000 and RE-prefixed order numbers confirmed working. WhatsApp number 919316565117 and Instagram @rari.ethnic correctly wired. No blocking issues — feature-complete MVP.
